# The Cub Who Listened

## Questions beneath the tree

Mara said, “A quiet voice can still carry a brave idea.”

“Why does the king growl when the cubs are near?”

Kojo said, “I watch the path so you can rest safely.”

“Even a small cub can learn to listen carefully.”

Pendo said, “A extraordinarilylongunbrokenwordextraordinarilylongunbrokenwordextraordinarilylongunbrokenword is big to me.”

“We can stay together while the shadows grow longer.”

A lion stood beside a tree and watched the moon rise above the grass.

## Answers along the path

Mara said, “Courage grows when we take one careful step.”

“The path looks different when a friend walks beside you.”

Kojo said, “Every quiet question deserves a patient answer.”

“Tomorrow we will tell the story in our own words.”

Pendo listened as the lion led the cubs home beneath the stars.
